title: Veterans Day Moment of Silence Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate passed version is repeated here.)

Veterans Day Moment of Silence Act

(Sec. 2) Directs the President to issue an annual proclamation calling on the people of the United States to observe two minutes of silence on Veterans Day, beginning at 3:11 p.m. Atlantic standard time, in honor of the service and sacrifice of veterans throughout the history of the nation.

summary.headline: A 2016 law asks the President each year to call on Americans to observe two minutes of silence on Veterans Day to honor veterans.
summary.what_it_does: The law directs the President to issue a yearly proclamation calling on people in the United States to observe two minutes of silence on Veterans Day. The silence begins at 3:11 p.m. Atlantic standard time. The purpose is to honor the service and sacrifice of veterans throughout the nation's history.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 7, 2016, and the yearly proclamation applies on each Veterans Day after that.
